name: @enhancely/adapter-lambda-edge
description: CloudFront Lambda@Edge origin-response adapter for the Enhancely JSON-LD injector (origin re-fetch pattern, fail-open)

scripts.package: pnpm run build && { cp connector-config.json dist/ 2>/dev/null || true; } && cd dist && rm -f lambda.zip && zip -q -X lambda.zip index.js && { zip -q lambda.zip connector-config.json >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; } && echo 'dist/lambda.zip ready'
